**Issue #3572 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3572: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S26, the set's look and sound
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It gives the set its look and sound, once every card part has landed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP3, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). The foundation (#3535) brings both onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

## Scope

- The set mark, the Almanac's and the deck builder's set chips, `FILTER_TAGS` for the new tags (Mindustrial, Mineral, the Automa tags, Paperclip, Wincon) and the `RELEASES` line, following Stinkyscape's S26 (#1883).
- The keyword glossary and icons for every new keyword and counter, each finished in the client where its engine part drew a first version: Evolve/Evolves and the Evolved mark, Burn, Toxic, GIGA, Flexible, Frenzy, Evasive, Tipsy's stein (and its blur), the Warhero Token's value, Refresh and Replenish, the per-turn damage pool's "{N left}", activate cooldowns.
- Intro-music specs for every Legendary and Mythic of the set (`gen:music`, `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`), and the voice lines, rendered with `[gen:voice]` (R1448): #4 Profe Yates (spawn: "Every pack needs an alpha I don't see anyone else stepping up"; attack: "a mouse once bit my sister"; death: "I will not see the Northern Lights again") and #141 Stinky 1x Engineer ("Prod is down. Report the intern.").
- Art: every card gets art the way the last set's cards did at release, with the art pipeline's placeholders where a brief is still to come. The ten Terminus Starships and the five Automa-ζ fusions each get art of their own (the designer).
- Every card face read in the browser at phone and desktop width (the `ui-walkthrough` skill), including GIGA permanents, Flexible Units in the backrow, the Black Hole and the slashed board. Screenshots go in a comment on this issue.

## Done when

- [ ] Everything in the scope is in, with web unit tests where a component changed, and `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` pass.
- [ ] No rule moves into the client (CLAUDE.md rule 7), and the client restates no number (rule 9).
- [ ] The set stays `Held` until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3551, #3541, #3542, #3552, #3544, #3537, #3559, #3555, #3547, #3556, #3549, #3545, #3560, #3565, #3566, #3553, #3538, #3557, #3567, #3568, #3561, #3569, #3539, #3570, #3571

Part of #3534.
```
